translations.literal: Standing firm in benevolence, reaching up to Heaven—he long had the will to withdraw but could not carry it through.
translations.idiomatic: Standing firm in benevolence that reaches up to Heaven, he had long wished to withdraw but could not bring himself to do it.

sentences.zh: 然今事急，不可不斷也。

translations.literal: Yet now matters are urgent—one cannot fail to decide.
translations.idiomatic: Yet now the crisis is upon us, and a decision cannot be postponed.

sentences.zh: 宋人方懼大敵，自救之師雖則畢集，未暇謀我。

translations.literal: The Song people now fear a great enemy; though their armies for self-defense are fully gathered, they have no leisure to plot against us.
translations.idiomatic: The Song now fear a great enemy; though their armies for self-defense are fully gathered, they have no leisure to plot against us.

sentences.zh: 第吾國內空虛，塔察國王與李行省肱髀相依，在於背脅；

translations.literal: Only our state within is empty; Prince Tacha and Regional Commander Li are like arm and thigh depending on each other, at our back and flank;
translations.idiomatic: Only at home we are hollow; Prince Tacha and Regional Commander Li cling to each other like arm and thigh, at our back and flank;

sentences.zh: 西域諸胡窺覘關隴，隔絕旭烈大王；

translations.literal: the various Hu of the Western Regions spy on Guanlong and cut off Prince Hulagu;
translations.idiomatic: the various Hu of the Western Regions spy on Guanlong and cut off Prince Hulagu;

sentences.zh: 病民諸姦各持兩端，觀望所立，莫不覬覦神器，染指垂涎。

translations.literal: suffering people and various traitors each hold to two sides, watching whom will be established, none not coveting the imperial regalia, dipping fingers and drooling.
translations.idiomatic: suffering people and various traitors each wait on two sides, watching who will be established, all coveting the throne and licking their lips.

sentences.zh: 一有狡焉，或啟戎心，先人舉事，腹背受敵，大事去矣。

translations.literal: Should one be crafty and perhaps rouse martial intent, strike first, and we be attacked front and rear, the great affair is lost.
translations.idiomatic: Should one be crafty and rouse martial intent, strike first, and we be attacked front and rear, the great affair is lost.

sentences.zh: 且阿里不哥已行赦令，令脫里赤為斷事官、行尚書省，據燕都，按圖籍，號令諸道，行皇帝事矣。

translations.literal: Moreover Ariq Böke has already issued an amnesty, appointing Toliči judicial officer and acting Secretariat, holding Yan capital, checking registers, commanding the circuits, and performing the emperor's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Ariq Böke has already issued an amnesty, appointing Toliči judicial officer and acting Secretariat, holding Yan capital, checking registers, commanding the circuits, and performing imperial affairs.

sentences.zh: 雖大王素有人望，且握重兵，獨不見金世宗、海陵之事乎！

translations.literal: Though Your Highness has long had popular esteem and holds heavy troops, have you alone not seen the affairs of Jin Shizong and Hailing?
translations.idiomatic: Though Your Highness has long enjoyed popular esteem and holds heavy troops, have you not seen what befell Jin Shizong and Prince Hailing?

sentences.zh: 若彼果決，稱受遺詔，便正位號，下詔中原，行赦江上，欲歸得乎？

translations.literal: If he is truly resolute, claims to receive the testamentary edict, then establishes his title, issues edicts in the Central Plains, and proclaims amnesty on the Yangtze—could you return?
translations.idiomatic: If he is truly resolute, claims the testamentary edict, establishes his title, issues edicts in the Central Plains, and proclaims amnesty on the Yangtze—could you still return?

sentences.zh: 昨奉命與張仲一觀新月城，自西南隅抵東北隅，萬人敵，上可並行大車，排槎ＯＣ樓，締構重覆，必不可攻，只有許和而歸耳。

translations.literal: Yesterday by order I viewed New Moon City with Zhang Zhongyi; from the southwest corner to the northeast corner it would withstand ten thousand men, on top chariots could pass side by side, rafts and towers were set in rows, structures layered in repetition—it absolutely cannot be taken; there is only to permit peace and return.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday by order I inspected New Moon City with Zhang Zhongyi; from southwest to northeast it would withstand ten thousand men, chariots could pass abreast on the ramparts, rafts and towers were set in rows, structures layered in repetition—it cannot be taken; we can only make peace and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 斷然班師，亟定大計，銷禍於未然。

translations.literal: Decisively withdraw the army, urgently fix the great plan, and extinguish disaster before it arises.
translations.idiomatic: Withdraw the army decisively, fix the great plan at once, and extinguish disaster before it arises.

sentences.zh: 先命勁兵把截江面，與宋議和，許割淮南、漢上、梓夔兩路，定疆界歲幣。

translations.literal: First order crack troops to block the river surface, negotiate peace with Song, promise to cede the Huainan, Hanshang, and Zikui circuits, and fix borders and annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: First order crack troops to block the river, negotiate peace with Song, promise to cede the Huainan, Hanshang, and Zikui circuits, and fix borders and annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 置輜重，以輕騎歸，渡淮乘驛，直造燕都，則從天而下，彼之奸謀僭志，冰釋瓦解。

translations.literal: Leave baggage, return with light cavalry, cross the Huai by post road and go straight to Yan capital—then descending from Heaven, their treacherous plots and usurping ambitions will melt like ice.
translations.idiomatic: Leave baggage, return with light cavalry, cross the Huai by post road and go straight to Yan capital—then descending from Heaven, their treacherous plots and usurping ambitions will melt like ice.

sentences.zh: 遣一軍逆蒙哥罕靈輿，收皇帝璽。

translations.literal: Send one army to meet Prince Möngke's funeral carriage and receive the imperial seal.
translations.idiomatic: Send one army to meet Prince Möngke's funeral carriage and receive the imperial seal.

sentences.zh: 遣使召旭烈、阿里不哥、摩哥及諸王駙馬，會喪和林。

translations.literal: Send envoys to summon Hulagu, Ariq Böke, Möngke, and the princes and imperial sons-in-law to assemble for mourning at Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: Send envoys to summon Hulagu, Ariq Böke, Möngke, and the princes and imperial sons-in-law to assemble for mourning at Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 差官於汴京、京兆、成都、西涼、東平、西京、北京，撫慰安輯，召真金太子鎮燕都，示以形勢。

translations.literal: Dispatch officials to Bianjing, Jingzhao, Chengdu, Xiliang, Dongping, Xijing, and Beijing to comfort and settle, summon Crown Prince Jingzhen to guard Yan capital and display the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch officials to Bianjing, Jingzhao, Chengdu, Xiliang, Dongping, Xijing, and Beijing to comfort and settle, summon Crown Prince Jingzhen to guard Yan capital and display the situation.

sentences.zh: 則大寶有歸，而社稷安矣。

translations.literal: Then the great treasure will have its place and the altars of state will be secure.
translations.idiomatic: Then the great inheritance will have its place and the altars of state will be secure.

sentences.zh: 會宋守帥賈似道亦遣間使請和，迺班師。

translations.literal: When Song defending commander-in-chief Jia Sidao also sent secret envoys seeking peace, the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Song defending commander-in-chief Jia Sidao also sent secret envoys seeking peace, the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年，世祖即位，以經為翰林侍讀學士，佩金虎符，充國信使使宋，告即位，且定和議，仍敕沿邊諸將毋鈔掠。

translations.literal: The following year, when the future Shizu took the throne, Jing was made Hanlin Reader, granted a gold tiger tally, and sent as credentialed envoy to Song to announce the enthronement and settle a peace agreement; border generals were also ordered not to raid.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when the future Shizu took the throne, Jing was made Hanlin Reader, granted a gold tiger tally, and sent as credentialed envoy to Song to announce the enthronement and settle a peace agreement; border generals were also ordered not to raid.

sentences.zh: 經入辭，賜蒲萄酒，詔曰：「朕初即位，庶事草創，卿當遠行，凡可輔朕者，亟以聞。」

translations.literal: Jing came to take leave; grape wine was bestowed, and an edict said: "I have just ascended the throne and all affairs are newly begun; you are about to travel far—whatever can aid me, report it without delay."
translations.idiomatic: Jing came to take leave; grape wine was bestowed, and an edict said: "I have just ascended the throne and all affairs are newly begun; you are about to travel far—whatever can aid me, report it without delay."

sentences.zh: 經奏便宜十六事，皆立政大要，辭多不載。

translations.literal: Jing memorialized sixteen immediate measures; all were essentials for establishing policy, but most of the wording is not recorded here.
translations.idiomatic: Jing memorialized sixteen immediate measures; all were essentials for establishing policy, but most of the wording is not recorded here.

sentences.zh: 時經有重名，平章王文統忌之。

translations.literal: At that time Jing had great reputation and Equal Administrator Wang Wentong envied him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jing enjoyed great reputation and Equal Administrator Wang Wentong envied him.

sentences.zh: 既行，文統陰屬李璮潛師侵宋，欲假手害經。

translations.literal: After Jing had departed, Wentong secretly instructed Li Tan to send troops in secret to invade Song, wishing to use another's hand to harm Jing.
translations.idiomatic: After Jing had departed, Wentong secretly instructed Li Tan to send troops in secret against Song, wishing to use another's hand to harm Jing.

sentences.zh: 經至濟南，璮以書止經，經以璮書聞於朝而行。

translations.literal: When Jing reached Jinan, Tan sent a letter stopping Jing; Jing reported Tan's letter to court and continued on his way.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing reached Jinan, Tan sent a letter stopping him; Jing reported Tan's letter to court and continued on his way.

sentences.zh: 宋敗璮軍於淮安，經至宿州，遣副使劉仁傑、參議高翿請入國日期，不報。

translations.literal: Song defeated Tan's army at Huai'an; Jing reached Suzhou and sent Vice Envoy Liu Renjie and Adviser Gao Hao to request a date for entering the state—no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Song defeated Tan's army at Huai'an; Jing reached Suzhou and sent Vice Envoy Liu Renjie and Adviser Gao Hao to request a date for entering the state—no reply came.

sentences.zh: 遺書宰相及淮帥李庭芝，庭芝復書果疑經，而賈似道方以卻敵為功，恐經至謀洩，竟館經真州。

translations.literal: He sent letters to the chief ministers and Huai commander Li Tingzhi; Tingzhi's reply indeed showed suspicion of Jing, while Jia Sidao was just then taking repelling the enemy as his achievement and feared that if Jing came his plot would leak—ultimately he lodged Jing at Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He sent letters to the chief ministers and Huai commander Li Tingzhi; Tingzhi's reply showed suspicion of Jing, while Jia Sidao was taking repelling the enemy as his achievement and feared that if Jing came his plot would leak—ultimately he detained Jing at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 經乃上表宋主曰：「願附魯連之義，排難解紛；

translations.literal: Jing thereupon memorialized the Song ruler saying: "I wish to attach myself to Lu Lian's righteousness and settle difficulties and dissolve strife;
translations.idiomatic: Jing thereupon memorialized the Song ruler, saying: "I wish to follow Lu Lian's example and settle difficulties and dissolve strife;

sentences.zh: 豈知唐儉之徒，款兵誤國。」

translations.literal: who knew that men like Tang Jian, with courteous troops, would mislead the state."
translations.idiomatic: who knew that men like Tang Jian, with courteous troops, would mislead the state."

sentences.zh: 又數上書宋主及宰執，極陳戰和利害，且請入見及歸國，皆不報。

translations.literal: He again repeatedly wrote to the Song ruler and chief ministers, fully setting forth the advantages and harms of war and peace, and also requesting an audience and return to his state—all without reply.
translations.idiomatic: He again repeatedly wrote to the Song ruler and chief ministers, fully setting forth the advantages and harms of war and peace, and requesting an audience and return to his state—all without reply.

sentences.zh: 驛吏棘垣鑰戶，晝夜守邏，欲以動經，經不屈。

translations.literal: Post clerks set thorn walls and locked doors, guarding day and night, wishing to move Jing—Jing would not bend.
translations.idiomatic: Post clerks set thorn walls and locked doors, guarding day and night, wishing to break Jing—Jing would not bend.

sentences.zh: 經待下素嚴，又久羈困，下多怨者。

translations.literal: Jing had always been strict with subordinates, and after long detention and hardship many below bore resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Jing had always been strict with subordinates, and after long detention many below bore resentment.

sentences.zh: 經諭曰：「向受命不進，我之罪也。

translations.literal: Jing instructed them saying: "Earlier, receiving orders and not advancing was my fault.
translations.idiomatic: Jing instructed them, saying: "Earlier, receiving orders and not advancing was my fault.

sentences.zh: 一入宋境，死生進退，聽其在彼，我終不能屈身辱命。

translations.literal: Once I entered Song territory, life, death, advance, and retreat are for them to decide; I can never humiliate myself and disgrace my commission.
translations.idiomatic: Once I entered Song territory, life, death, advance, and retreat are for them to decide; I can never humiliate myself and disgrace my commission.

sentences.zh: 汝等不幸，宜忍以待之，我觀宋祚將不久矣。」

translations.literal: You are unfortunate and should endure and wait; I observe that Song's fortune will not be long."
translations.idiomatic: You are unfortunate and should endure and wait; I observe that Song's fortune will not last long."

sentences.zh: 居七年，從者怒鬥，死者數人，經獨與六人處別館。

translations.literal: After seven years, followers fought in anger and several died; Jing alone remained with six men in a separate lodge.
translations.idiomatic: After seven years, followers fought in anger and several died; Jing alone remained with six men in a separate lodge.

sentences.zh: 又九年，丞相伯顏奉詔南伐，帝遣禮部尚書中都海牙及經弟行樞密院都事郝庸入宋，問執行人之罪，宋懼，遣總管段佑以禮送經歸。

translations.literal: After another nine years, Chancellor Bayan received orders for the southern campaign; the emperor sent Minister of Rites Zhongdu Haiya and Jing's younger brother Acting Privy Council Executive Hao Yong into Song to inquire about the crime of detaining an envoy; Song was afraid and sent Chief Administrator Duan You to escort Jing home with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: After another nine years, Chancellor Bayan received orders for the southern campaign; the emperor sent Minister of Rites Zhongdu Haiya and Jing's younger brother Acting Privy Council Executive Hao Yong into Song to inquire about the crime of detaining an envoy; Song was afraid and sent Chief Administrator Duan You to escort Jing home with ceremony.

sentences.zh: 賈似道之謀既洩，尋亦竄死。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao's plot had already leaked and soon he also died in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao's plot had already leaked and soon he died in flight as well.

sentences.zh: 經歸，道病，帝敕樞密院及尚醫近侍迎勞，所過父老瞻望流涕。

translations.literal: When Jing returned he fell ill on the road; the emperor ordered the Privy Council and imperial physicians and close attendants to welcome and comfort him; wherever he passed, elders gazed and wept.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing returned he fell ill on the road; the emperor ordered the Privy Council and imperial physicians and close attendants to welcome and comfort him; wherever he passed, elders gazed and wept.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，至闕，錫燕大庭，諮以政事，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: The next summer he reached the court, was granted a feast in the great hall, consulted on government affairs, and rewarded according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: The next summer he reached court, was granted a feast in the great hall, consulted on government affairs, and rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，卒，年五十三，官為護喪還葬，諡文忠。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he died at fifty-three; officials escorted the funeral for burial and he was given posthumous title Wenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn he died at fifty-three; officials escorted the funeral for burial and he was given posthumous title Wenzhong.

sentences.zh: 明年，宋平。

translations.literal: The next year Song was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Song was pacified.

sentences.zh: 經為人尚氣節，為學務有用。

translations.literal: Jing as a man valued integrity and in learning pursued what was useful.
translations.idiomatic: Jing as a man valued integrity; in learning he pursued what was useful.

sentences.zh: 及被留，思託言垂後，撰《續後漢書》、《易春秋外傳》、《太極演》、《原古錄》、《通鑑書法》、《玉衡貞觀》等書及文集，凡數百卷。

translations.literal: When detained he wished to entrust words to posterity and compiled the Continuation of the Book of Han, Outer Commentary on the Changes and Spring and Autumn Annals, Elaboration of the Supreme Ultimate, Record of Antiquity, Calligraphy of the Comprehensive Mirror, Jade Balance and Constant Observation, and other books and collected works, altogether several hundred juan.
translations.idiomatic: When detained he wished to entrust words to posterity and compiled the Continuation of the Book of Han, Outer Commentary on the Changes and Spring and Autumn Annals, Elaboration of the Supreme Ultimate, Record of Antiquity, Calligraphy of the Comprehensive Mirror, Jade Balance and Constant Observation, and other books and collected works, altogether several hundred juan.

sentences.zh: 其文豐蔚豪宕，善議論。

translations.literal: His prose was rich and bold, good at disputation.
translations.idiomatic: His prose was rich and bold, and he excelled at disputation.

sentences.zh: 詩多奇崛。

translations.literal: His poetry was often strange and towering.
translations.idiomatic: His poetry was often strange and towering.

sentences.zh: 拘宋十六年，從者皆通於學。

translations.literal: Detained in Song for sixteen years, his followers all became versed in learning.
translations.idiomatic: Detained in Song for sixteen years, his followers all became versed in learning.

sentences.zh: 書佐苟宗道，後官至國子祭酒。

translations.literal: His clerk Gou Zongdao later reached office as Chancellor of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: His clerk Gou Zongdao later reached office as Chancellor of the National University.

sentences.zh: 經還之歲，汴中民射雁金明池，得系帛，書詩云：「霜落風高恣所如，歸期回首是春初。

translations.literal: In the year Jing returned, people of Bian shot geese at Jinming Pool and obtained attached silk with a poem saying: "Frost falls and wind rises—go where you will; the day you turn homeward is the start of spring.
translations.idiomatic: In the year Jing returned, people of Bian shot geese at Jinming Pool and obtained attached silk with a poem saying: "Frost falls and wind rises—go where you will; the day you turn homeward is the start of spring.

sentences.zh: 上林天子援弓繳，窮海累臣有帛書。」

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven of the Upper Park draws his bow with silken cord; the minister long exiled at the edge of the sea has a message on silk."
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven of the Upper Park draws his bow with silken cord; the minister long exiled at the edge of the sea has a message on silk."

sentences.zh: 後題曰：「至元五年九月一日放雁，獲者勿殺，國信大使郝經書於真州忠勇軍營新館。」

translations.literal: The later inscription read: "On the first day of the ninth month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan a goose was released; whoever obtains it should not kill it. Written by credentialed envoy Hao Jing at the new lodge of the Loyal and Brave Army camp at Zhenzhou."
translations.idiomatic: The later inscription read: "On the first day of the ninth month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan a goose was released; whoever obtains it should not kill it. Written by credentialed envoy Hao Jing at the new lodge of the Loyal and Brave Army camp at Zhenzhou."

sentences.zh: 其忠誠如此。

translations.literal: Such was his loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Such was his loyalty.

sentences.zh: 二弟彝、庸，皆有名。

translations.literal: Two younger brothers Yi and Yong were both renowned.
translations.idiomatic: Two younger brothers Yi and Yong were both renowned.

sentences.zh: 彝字仲常，隱居以壽終；

translations.literal: Yi, style name Zhongchang, lived in seclusion and died of old age;
translations.idiomatic: Yi, styled Zhongchang, lived in seclusion and died of old age;

sentences.zh: 庸字季常，終潁州守。

translations.literal: Yong, style name Jichang, ended as prefect of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yong, styled Jichang, ended as prefect of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 子採麟，亦賢，起家知林州，仕至山南江北道肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: His son Cailin was also worthy; he began office as magistrate of Lin Prefecture and served to Surveillance Commissioner of the Shannan Jiangbei Circuit for Purging Corruption.
translations.idiomatic: His son Cailin was also worthy; he began office as magistrate of Lin Prefecture and served to Surveillance Commissioner of the Shannan Jiangbei Circuit for Purging Corruption.
